summary: You produced a strong end-to-end design for a single SSO satellite to monitor GBR bleaching using fluid lensing, supported by STK. Your mission rationale, launch, orbit and ground contact analysis are comprehensive. To improve, correct orbital mechanics descriptions and add quantitative justification for EOL and launch selection, and improve figure and reference formatting.

criteria.C1: You covered all four prompts well in Introduction: primary EO mission with fluid lensing and AI, reef bleaching rationale with references, single-satellite justification for simplicity, and users CSIRO/BOM as customers. This meets Accomplished. For 9-10, add more detail on user operations and data flow.
criteria.C2: Excellent work in Mission Design: Guiana Space Centre rationale, 600km SSO with a=6971km and inc=97.7924 deg with trade plot, STK COE table and access reports showing 10-min contacts via Mount Pleasant. To reach top of Accomplished, add mass/performance check for Vega-E, correct RAAN description in Orbit table, and delta-V/area/lifetime calc for drag sail EOL.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion effectively summarises launch, SSO, ground station and EOL and links back to the bleaching problem, noting Vega E availability risk. To strengthen, draw more explicit quantitative conclusions from your STK access results and trade studies, not just restating design choices.
criteria.C4: You used a clear engineering structure with Executive Summary and headings and readable prose. To move to Accomplished, number and caption all figures/tables e.g., Image 1 screenshot, and replace bare URLs and Wikipedia in Bibliography with proper cited references matching in-text citations consistently.
